# Pishdad
> The first Persian-first, self-hosted CMS. Free and MIT-licensed, built for
> right-to-left Persian, and verified before any plugin code runs.

Pishdad (پیشداد) is a plugin-based content management system for building and managing
websites. It is named after the Pishdadians, the first dynasty of the Shahnameh.

## Stack
- Backend: Laravel 11 (API-only), PHP 8.2+
- Frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript
- Data: PostgreSQL 14+ (fa-IR collation), Redis, MinIO (S3-compatible)
- API: OpenAPI 3.1, 135 endpoints · Tests: PHPUnit, 489 tests

## What makes it different
- Persian and RTL from the first commit: CSS logical properties, Jalali dates, a locally
  served Persian typeface, no external CDN.
- Plugins are declarative and signed. A package declares permissions, widgets and page
  types in a manifest and is signed with Ed25519. The trust store verifies the signature
  before any plugin code loads; a package with an embedded credential is rejected.
- SEO tooling is in the core, not an add-on: sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt, search.

## Licensing and hosting
Free and MIT-licensed: no premium edition, no seat count, no telemetry. Self-hosted, so it
runs on a server you control and your data stays there.
